name: Brisk Walking
description: A comfortable, sustained brisk walk outdoors or on a treadmill.
instructions: Keep back straight, arms swinging naturally. Aim for a pace where you can talk but feel slightly breathless.
contraindicationNotes: Very low impact, suitable for most fitness levels including beginners.

name: Jogging / Running
description: Steady-state jogging at a comfortable conversational pace.
instructions: Warm up with a 5-minute walk. Maintain a pace where you can speak short sentences. Cool down with a 5-minute walk.
contraindicationNotes: Moderate impact. Use proper footwear. Avoid on knee injuries.

name: HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
description: Alternating 40 seconds of high-intensity effort with 20 seconds rest.
instructions: Exercises: burpees, jump squats, mountain climbers, high knees. Always warm up 5 min before. Not for beginners.
contraindicationNotes: High impact. Not recommended for beginners or those with joint issues.

name: Bodyweight Squats
description: Classic bodyweight squats targeting quads, glutes, and hamstrings.
instructions: 3 sets of 15 reps. Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out. Lower until thighs parallel to floor. Keep knees over toes.
contraindicationNotes: Modify with chair support for beginners. Avoid deep squats with knee pain.

name: Push-Ups
description: Classic push-ups targeting chest, shoulders, and triceps.
instructions: 3 sets of 10-15 reps. Keep body in a straight line. Beginners can start with knee push-ups.
contraindicationNotes: Can modify with knees for beginners or those with wrist issues.

name: Plank Hold
description: Core-stabilizing plank exercise for full-body strength.
instructions: 3 sets. Start with 20-30 seconds, build to 60+ seconds. Keep hips level, core engaged.
contraindicationNotes: Low impact but requires wrist/shoulder stability.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
description: Isolated bicep curls to build arm strength.
instructions: 3 sets of 12 reps each arm. Keep elbows close to body, curl slowly, lower with control.
contraindicationNotes: Start with lighter weights. Proper form is essential.

name: Deadlifts
description: Compound movement for total body strength focusing on posterior chain.
instructions: 3 sets of 6-8 reps. Hinge at hips, keep back flat, push through heels. Learn form with light weight first.
contraindicationNotes: Learn proper form before adding heavy weight. Not for lower-back injuries.

name: Bench Press
description: Classic compound chest exercise for upper body strength.
instructions: 3 sets of 8-10 reps. Keep feet flat, back slightly arched, lower bar to chest, press to lockout.
contraindicationNotes: Always use a spotter. Start with lighter weights to learn form.

name: Swimming
description: Full-body low-impact cardio exercise in water.
instructions: Alternate between freestyle and breaststroke. 10 laps to start, increase gradually.
contraindicationNotes: Excellent low-impact option. Great for joint issues.

name: Cycling
description: Cycling for cardio fitness and lower body strength.
instructions: Keep cadence steady at 80-100 RPM. Adjust resistance to maintain moderate intensity.
contraindicationNotes: Low impact on joints. Good for knee recovery.

name: Jump Rope
description: High-intensity cardio exercise that improves coordination and burns calories fast.
instructions: 2 minutes jumping, 1 minute rest, repeat 5 times. Keep wrists doing the work, not arms.
contraindicationNotes: High impact. Avoid with joint issues. Good surface required.

name: Lunges
description: Walking or stationary lunges for leg and glute development.
instructions: 3 sets of 12 reps each leg. Step forward, lower back knee toward floor. Keep front knee over ankle.
contraindicationNotes: Modify with shorter range of motion for knee discomfort.

name: Yoga-Pilates Blend
description: Combining yoga flexibility with Pilates core strengthening.
instructions: Flow through sun salutations, then core Pilates sequence. Focus on breath and form.
contraindicationNotes: Low impact, suitable for most fitness levels.

name: Dance / Zumba
description: Fun, rhythm-based aerobic dance workout.
instructions: Follow along with a class or video. Stay hydrated. Focus on having fun!
contraindicationNotes: Low to moderate impact depending on intensity chosen.

name: Pull-Ups / Chin-Ups
description: Upper body compound movement for back, biceps, and grip strength.
instructions: 3 sets to failure. Beginners use resistance bands for assistance. Full range of motion.
contraindicationNotes: High effort. Use band assistance until 5+ reps achieved.

name: Glute Bridges
description: Hip-lifting exercise targeting glutes, hamstrings, and lower back.
instructions: 3 sets of 15-20 reps. Lie on back, feet flat, drive hips upward. Hold 2 seconds at top.
contraindicationNotes: Very low impact, excellent for lower back health.

name: Resistance Band Exercises
description: Full body resistance band workout including rows, presses, and squats.
instructions: Target major muscle groups. 3 sets of 12-15 reps per exercise. Control the movement.
contraindicationNotes: Very safe. Good for home workouts and rehabilitation.

name: Outdoor Sports (Cricket, Football, Badminton)
description: Playing outdoor team or racket sports for fitness and enjoyment.
instructions: Warm up before play. Engage fully in the game. Stay hydrated.
contraindicationNotes: Excellent for children's physical development and social skills.

name: Swimming Lessons (Child)
description: Structured swimming for children focusing on technique and water confidence.
instructions: Always with adult supervision. Focus on floating, kicking, and basic strokes.
contraindicationNotes: Always supervise children in water. Life vest for non-swimmers.

name: Stair Climbing
description: Using stairs for an effective cardio and lower-body workout.
instructions: Climb at a brisk pace. Use hand rail for balance. 10-15 flights or 20 minutes total.
contraindicationNotes: Good for cardiovascular fitness. Avoid with knee issues.

name: Overhead Shoulder Press
description: Vertical pressing movement for shoulder and upper body strength.
instructions: 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Press weights directly overhead, control the descent.
contraindicationNotes: Avoid with shoulder impingement. Start with lighter weights.

name: Core Ab Workout
description: Circuit of crunches, leg raises, bicycle crunches, and planks.
instructions: 3 rounds: 20 crunches, 15 leg raises, 20 bicycle, 45-second plank. Rest 60 sec between rounds.
contraindicationNotes: Avoid sit-ups with lower back pain. Use plank instead.

name: Stretching & Mobility Routine
description: Full body stretching routine targeting major muscle groups.
instructions: Hold each stretch 20-30 seconds. Breathe deeply. No bouncing. Morning or post-workout.
contraindicationNotes: Very safe. Recommended for all fitness levels as recovery.

name: Rowing Machine
description: Full-body cardio on a rowing machine, engaging arms, core, and legs.
instructions: 60% legs, 20% core, 20% arms pull sequence. Maintain straight back throughout.
contraindicationNotes: Low impact, excellent total-body workout.

name: Pelvic Floor Exercises (Kegels)
description: Targeted pelvic floor strengthening exercises.
instructions: Contract pelvic floor muscles for 5 seconds, release for 5 seconds. 3 sets of 10 repetitions.
contraindicationNotes: Can be done anywhere. Beneficial for overall women's pelvic health.

name: Skipping (Child)
description: Fun skipping and jump-rope play for children.
instructions: Start with basic jumps, progress to alternating feet. Take breaks as needed.
contraindicationNotes: Fun and engaging for children. Builds coordination.

name: Hip Hinge / Romanian Deadlift
description: Posterior chain exercise for hamstrings, glutes, and lower back.
instructions: 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Hinge at hips, slight knee bend, lower weights along legs. Feel hamstring stretch.
contraindicationNotes: Excellent for posterior chain strength without heavy barbell.

name: Playground Activities (Child)
description: Unstructured play including climbing, swinging, running, and jumping.
instructions: Encourage free play in safe environment. Variety of activities builds motor skills.
contraindicationNotes: Essential for healthy child development. Ensure adult supervision.

name: Elliptical Trainer
description: Low-impact elliptical cardio targeting full body.
instructions: Maintain upright posture, push and pull arms actively. Adjust resistance for intensity.
contraindicationNotes: Very low impact on joints. Great for injury recovery.

name: Gentle Walking (Recovery)
description: Light, comfortable walking for active recovery and gentle movement.
instructions: Walk at an easy, comfortable pace. Focus on breathing. Outdoors if possible.
contraindicationNotes: Ideal during menstrual recovery days or when energy is low.

name: Battle Ropes
description: High-intensity upper body cardio using thick battle ropes.
instructions: 30-second intervals: alternating waves, bilateral waves, slams. Rest 30 sec between sets.
contraindicationNotes: High intensity. Not for beginners. Good shoulder stability required.
